Production Engineer - Couvet site — Sintetica SA, Couvet (NE).

Production Engineer - Couvet site

Established in 1921 in Switzerland, Sintetica is a pharmaceutical company delivering injectable anesthetics and analgesics to patients worldwide, through innovative science and excellence in development, production and marketing. Our people are the biggest asset.  That is why we promote creativity in an exciting environment. To strengthen our Pharmaceutical Development team in Couvet (Neuchâtel), we are currently looking for a

Production Engineer

The candidate will ensure that manufacturing processes consistently delivers compliant product output in a robust, repeatable, efficient, and safe way—keeping operations in a state of control while systematically reducing waste, variability, and quality risk. The production engineer ensures business continuity, increases process robustness and overlooks continuous improvement of production operations (aseptic and terminal sterilized processes), providing technical and GMP competences. The role will both support daily production activities and execute improvement projects in compliance area and translate operational excellence strategic initiatives into actions. The role will report to production manager and collaborate with QA, maintenance and supply chain departments.

Main responsibilities

• Support the production manager in daily activities, ensuring business continuity and GMP compliance of production processes: mitigate technical and operational risks; lead weekly production planning execution; support shopfloor daily activities; when needed, coordinate and supervise production crew setup and allocation

• Develop and implement training plan for production crew to ensure required level of polyvalence

• Identify and integrate best practices and optimized working methods to increase safety, quality and productivity; be the focal point for the continuous improvement process in shopfloor.

• Collaborate with other industrial departments to mitigate unplanned events and develop remediation plans: support qualification, validation and metrology activities with QA department; collaborate to improve machineries availability with Maintenance Department

• Manage quality events related to production (change control, deviations, CAPA, claims): lead root caused analysis and investigation adopt standardized tools; implement effective preventive and corrective actions; contribute to reduce recurring deviations

• Prepare and review production documentations (batch record, SOPs)

• Drive and execute efficiency and initiatives to enhance operational excellence, improve production yield and reduce OPEX under guidance of OPEX lead

• Support the implementation of CAPEX projects related to production processes and equipment

• Interface with supply chain for components stock management and production plan optimization

• Interface with finance on production-related cost topics, on manufacturing cost structure, stock management

Requirements

• Degree in process engineering, chemical engineer or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in sterile production, including mandatory experience with aseptic processing and terminal sterilization operations.

• Demonstrated knowledge in GMP regulations; know-how on Annex 1 and contamination control will be considered as a real asset

• Experience with Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies

• Strong problem solving and analytical approach

• Structured, focused and organized way of working

• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken)

We offer permanent, full-time employment in a stimulating, dynamic work environment where a positive culture rich in diversity prevails.

Sintetica promotes gender equality and encourages the personal development of its employees.

Ingegnere di produzione - Sito Couvet — Sintetica SA, Couvet (NE).

Ingegnere di Produzione - Sito Couvet

Fondata nel 1921 in Svizzera, Sintetica è un'azienda farmaceutica che offre anestetici e analgesici iniettabili ai pazienti di tutto il mondo, attraverso la scienza innovativa e l'eccellenza nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nel marketing. La nostra gente e' la risorsa piu' grande. Ecco perché promuoviamo la creatività in un ambiente emozionante. Per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo farmaceutico a Couvet (Neuchâtel), stiamo attualmente cercando un

Ingegnere di produzione

Il candidato si assicurerà che i processi produttivi conseguano in modo robusto, ripetibile, efficiente e sicuro le operazioni di mantenimento in uno stato di controllo, riducendo sistematicamente i rifiuti, la variabilità e il rischio di qualità. L'ingegnere di produzione garantisce continuità aziendale, aumenta la robustezza del processo e si affaccia sul continuo miglioramento delle operazioni di produzione (processi di sterilizzazione asettica e terminale), fornendo competenze tecniche e GMP. Il ruolo sosterrà sia le attività di produzione quotidiane e realizzerà progetti di miglioramento nell'area di conformità e tradurrà iniziative strategiche di eccellenza operativa in azioni. Il ruolo si riferirà al responsabile della produzione e collaborerà con i servizi QA, manutenzione e supply chain.

Principali responsabilità

• Sostenere il responsabile della produzione nelle attività quotidiane, garantire la continuità aziendale e la conformità GMP ai processi produttivi: mitigare i rischi tecnici e operativi; condurre l'esecuzione settimanale della pianificazione della produzione; sostenere le attività quotidiane del negozio; quando necessario, coordinare e supervisionare la configurazione e l'allocazione dell'equipaggio di produzione

• Sviluppare e implementare il piano di formazione per l'equipaggio di produzione per garantire il livello richiesto di polivalenza

• Identificare e integrare le migliori pratiche e i metodi di lavoro ottimizzati per aumentare la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività; essere il punto focale per il continuo processo di miglioramento in shopfloor.

• Collaborare con altri dipartimenti industriali per mitigare gli eventi non pianificati e sviluppare piani di bonifica: attività di qualificazione, validazione e metrologia con il dipartimento QA; collaborare per migliorare la disponibilità dei macchinari con il reparto manutenzione

• Gestire gli eventi di qualità relativi alla produzione (controllo di cambiamento, deviazioni, CAPA, reclami): l'analisi causata dal piombo e l'indagine adottano strumenti standardizzati; implementare efficaci azioni preventive e correttive; contribuire a ridurre le deviazioni ricorrenti

• Preparare e rivedere i documenti di produzione (batch record, SOPs)

• Guidare ed eseguire efficienza e iniziative per migliorare l'eccellenza operativa, migliorare la resa produttiva e ridurre OPEX sotto la guida di OPEX

• Sostenere l'attuazione dei progetti CAPEX relativi ai processi produttivi e alle attrezzature

• Interfaccia con supply chain per la gestione dei componenti e l'ottimizzazione del piano di produzione

• Interfaccia con finanza su argomenti relativi ai costi di produzione, su struttura dei costi di produzione, gestione delle scorte

Requisiti

• Laurea in ingegneria dei processi, ingegnere chimico o campi correlati

• Esperienza minima di 5 anni nella produzione sterile, compresa l'esperienza obbligatoria con operazioni di lavorazione asettica e sterilizzazione terminale.

• Conoscenza dimostrata nelle normative GMP; il know-how sull'allegato 1 e il controllo della contaminazione saranno considerati un vero e proprio asset

• Esperienza con la produzione di magra e metodi di miglioramento continuo

• Forte problem solving e approccio analitico

• Strutturato, focalizzato e organizzato modo di lavorare

• Fluente in francese e inglese (scritto e parlato)

Offriamo un lavoro permanente e a tempo pieno in un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico in cui prevale una cultura positiva ricca di diversità.

Produktionsingenieur - Couvet Site

Sintetica wurde 1921 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein Pharmaunternehmen, das injizierbare Anästhetika und Analgetika an Patienten weltweit durch innovative Wissenschaft und Exzellenz in Entwicklung, Produktion und Marketing liefert. Unser Volk ist das größte Kapital. Deshalb fördern wir Kreativität in einem spannenden Umfeld. Um unser Pharmaentwicklungsteam in Couvet (Neuenburg) zu stärken, suchen wir derzeit eine

Produktionsingenieur

Der Kandidat wird sicherstellen, dass Fertigungsprozesse konsistent konforme Produktergebnisse in einer robusten, wiederholbaren, effizienten und sicheren Weise liefern - die Abläufe in einem Zustand der Kontrolle halten und gleichzeitig Abfall, Variabilität und Qualitätsrisiken systematisch reduzieren. Der Produktionsingenieur sorgt für Geschäftskontinuität, erhöht die Prozessrobustheit und übersieht die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsvorgänge (aseptische und terminale sterilisierte Prozesse) und bietet technische und GMP-Kompetenzen. Die Rolle wird sowohl die täglichen Produktionsaktivitäten unterstützen als auch Verbesserungsprojekte im Compliance-Bereich durchführen und strategische Initiativen für operative Exzellenz in Maßnahmen umsetzen. Die Rolle wird an den Produktionsleiter berichten und mit QA, Wartungs- und Lieferkettenabteilungen zusammenarbeiten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Industrieabteilungen, um ungeplante Ereignisse zu mildern und Sanierungspläne zu entwickeln: Unterstützung von Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- und Metrologieaktivitäten mit der QA-Abteilung; Zusammenarbeit zur Verbesserung der Verfügbarkeit von Maschinen mit der Wartungsabteilung

• Management von Qualitätsereignissen im Zusammenhang mit der Produktion (Änderungskontrolle, Abweichungen, CAPA, Ansprüche): Analyse und Untersuchung durch Bleiwurzeln führen standardisierte Tools ein, implementieren wirksame Präventiv- und Korrekturmaßnahmen und tragen dazu bei, wiederkehrende Abweichungen zu reduzieren

• Förderung und Umsetzung von Effizienz und Initiativen zur Verbesserung der operativen Exzellenz, Verbesserung der Produktionsausbeute und Reduzierung von OPEX unter Anleitung von OPEX Lead

Ingénieur de production - Site de Couvet — Sintetica SA, Couvet (NE).

Ingénieur de production - Site de Couvet

Fondée en 1921 en Suisse, Sintetica est une société pharmaceutique qui fournit des anesthésiques injectables et des analgésiques aux patients du monde entier, grâce à la science innovante et à l'excellence dans le développement, la production et la commercialisation. Notre peuple est le plus gros atout. C'est pourquoi nous encourageons la créativité dans un environnement passionnant. Pour renforcer notre équipe de développement pharmaceutique à Couvet (Neuchâtel), nous sommes à la recherche d'un

Ingénieur de production

Le candidat s'assurera que les processus de fabrication assurent systématiquement une production de produits conforme de manière robuste, répétable, efficace et sûre, tout en réduisant systématiquement les déchets, la variabilité et le risque de qualité. L'ingénieur de production assure la continuité des opérations, augmente la robustesse des processus et néglige l'amélioration continue des opérations de production (procédés aseptiques et stérilisés terminaux), fournissant des compétences techniques et des BPF. Ce rôle appuiera les activités quotidiennes de production et exécutera des projets d'amélioration dans le domaine de la conformité et traduira les initiatives stratégiques d'excellence opérationnelle en actions. Ce rôle relèvera du gestionnaire de la production et collaborera avec les ministères de l'AQ, de l'entretien et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

Principales responsabilités

• Soutenir le responsable de la production dans les activités quotidiennes, en assurant la continuité des activités et la conformité aux BPF des processus de production : atténuer les risques techniques et opérationnels; diriger l'exécution hebdomadaire de la planification de la production; soutenir les activités quotidiennes des ateliers; au besoin, coordonner et superviser la mise en place et l'attribution des équipes de production

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre un plan de formation pour l'équipe de production afin d'assurer le niveau de polyvalence requis

• Identifier et intégrer les meilleures pratiques et les méthodes de travail optimisées pour accroître la sécurité, la qualité et la productivité; être le point central du processus d'amélioration continue dans les ateliers.

• Collaborer avec d'autres départements industriels pour atténuer les événements imprévus et élaborer des plans d'assainissement : soutenir les activités de qualification, de validation et de métrologie avec le département de l'AQ; collaborer pour améliorer la disponibilité des machines avec le département de maintenance

• Gérer les événements de qualité liés à la production (contrôle du changement, écarts, PACA, allégations) : l'analyse et l'enquête sur les causes principales adoptent des outils normalisés; mettent en oeuvre des mesures préventives et correctives efficaces; contribuent à réduire les écarts récurrents

• Préparer et examiner les documents de production (enregistrement par lots, PON)

• Diriger et exécuter des initiatives et des initiatives visant à améliorer l'excellence opérationnelle, à améliorer le rendement de production et à réduire l'OPEX sous la direction de l'OPEX

• Soutenir la mise en œuvre des projets CAPEX relatifs aux processus de production et aux équipements

• Interface avec la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour la gestion des stocks de composants et l'optimisation du plan de production

• Interface avec le financement sur des sujets liés aux coûts de production, sur la structure des coûts de fabrication, la gestion des stocks

Exigences

• Diplôme en génie des procédés, génie chimique ou domaines connexes

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la production stérile, y compris l'expérience obligatoire dans le traitement aseptique et les opérations de stérilisation terminale.

• Les connaissances démontrées en matière de réglementation des BPF; le savoir-faire sur l'annexe 1 et la lutte contre la contamination seront considérés comme un actif réel

• Expérience des méthodes de fabrication et d'amélioration continue de Lean

• Solution de problèmes et approche analytique

• Mode de travail structuré, ciblé et organisé

• Fluent en français et en anglais (écrit et parlé)

Nous offrons un emploi permanent à plein temps dans un environnement de travail stimulant et dynamique où règne une culture positive riche en diversité.

PV Project Manager and Deputy QPPV – Mendrisio site (Ticino) — Sintetica SA, Mendrisio (TI).

PV Project Manager and Deputy QPPV – Mendrisio site (Ticino)

Founded in 1921 and headquartered in Mendrisio (Switzerland), Sintetica's mission is to continuously strive to improve therapies by enhancing its products' formulations and usability for the benefit of clinicians and patients.

We do so in close cooperation with clinical experts, who shape our understanding of their unmet needs and drive our efforts to address them. With this trust and insight, we push the limits of science and technology to make therapies safer for patients and easier to perform. Every year we reliably supply millions of doses of our products across a range of therapeutic classes, including anaesthesia and analgesia, while expanding to address further healthcare needs.

To strengthen our Pharmacovigilance team at our headquarter in Mendrisio (Switzerland), we are currently looking for a PV Project Manager and Deputy QPPV.

Position Summary

The Pharmacovigilance (PV) Project Manager and Deputy QPPV will report directly to the Corporate Drug Safety Manager, QPPV & Vigilance MD Responsible Person, playing a strategic role in supporting the oversight, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the global Pharmacovigilance system, ensuring full compliance with applicable Swiss, EU and international regulations.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate Pharmacovigilance projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business and regulatory requirements.

• Act as Deputy QPPV, ensuring continuity of Pharmacovigilance operations, regulatory compliance, and appropriate oversight during periods of QPPV absence.

• Oversee global Pharmacovigilance system activities, ensuring compliance with Swiss, EU, and international regulations.

• Support the maintenance of Swiss and Global Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), coordinating input from internal functions and external partners.

• Lead signal management activities and contribute to the benefit-risk evaluation of Company’s products.

• Coordinate safety communications including Direct Healthcare Professional Communications (DHPCs).

• Oversee the preparation and submission of aggregate safety reports (PSUR/PBRER, DSUR).

• Ensure end-to-end oversight of adverse event collection, assessment and reporting from all sources (spontaneous reports, clinical trials, literature, partners).

• Maintain strong collaboration with the affiliate, commercial partners and external vendors to ensure global PV compliance.

• Oversee the Global Safety Database and support system maintenance, upgrades and configuration activities.

• Monitor regulatory intelligence and ensure compliance with EudraVigilance and other applicable reporting requirements.

• Support the development, review, and maintenance of SOPs and controlled PV documentation.

• Ensure inspection readiness and contribute to continuous improvement of the PV system across the product lifecycle (pre- and post-authorization activities).

Qualifications and skills

• Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific or healthcare discipline (e.g. Pharmacy, Medicine, Biology, Chemistry or related field).

• At least 5–8 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

• Strong knowledge of EU GVP modules, ICH guidelines, Swiss and global PV regulations.

• Previous experience as Deputy QPPV or in a senior PV role is strongly preferred.

• Experience with signal management, aggregate reporting, PSMF, and safety databases (e.g. Veeva Vault Safety).

• Solid experience in PV project management and cross-functional coordination.

• Excellent command of written and spoken Italian and English; French is a plus.

• Familiarity with regulatory inspections and compliance processes is an advantage.

Preference will be given to candidates based in Switzerland.

We offer

Fulltime permanent employment in a dynamic and scientifically driven working environment.

Sintetica promotes diversity and gender equality.

Fulltime permanent employment in a young working environment and positive culture.

• Evaluate extractables and leachable risk in collaboration with analytical team.

• Evaluate nitrosamines risk in collaboration with analytical team.

• Support aseptic processing or terminal sterilization strategy selection.

• Support scale-up activities and technology transfer to manufacturing.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Regulatory Affairs.

• Improve galenical development and formulations selection by attending courses, seminars and meetings.

Qualifications and skills

• Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific discipline (Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry).

• At least 10 years of post-degree work experience, including at least 5 years in Pharma R&D context.

• Familiarity with both small and macro-molecules API.

• Demonstrated expertise in injectable and/or ophthalmic formulation development.

• Proven hands-on expertise in aseptic processing, sterilization strategies, and lyophilization cycle development.

• Practical experience applying QbD principles and/or DoE in drug product development.

• Strong experience with late-stage development, scale-up and commercial product support.

• Familiarity with ICH/EU/US/Swiss laboratory guidelines related to the technical subjects.

Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Technician - Mendrisio Site (Ticino) — Sintetica SA, Mendrisio (TI).

Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Technician - Mendrisio Site (Ticino)

Founded in 1921 and headquartered in Mendrisio (Switzerland), Sintetica's mission is to continuously strive to improve therapies by enhancing its products' formulations and usability for the benefit of clinicians and patients.

We do so in close cooperation with clinical experts, who shape our understanding of their unmet needs and drive our efforts to address them. With this trust and insight, we push the limits of science and technology to make therapies safer for patients and easier to perform. Every year we reliably supply millions of doses of our products across a range of therapeutic classes, including anaesthesia and analgesia, while expanding to address further healthcare needs.

To strengthen our Quality Control department at our headquarter in Mendrisio (Switzerland), we are currently looking for a Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Technician.

Job Description

The Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Technician plays an essential role in the laboratory’s day-to-day operations, ensuring that the activities assigned to the microbiological laboratory are carried out within the established timelines and in compliance with procedures.

The Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Technician will report to the Quality Control Microbiological Laboratory Responsible

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct environmental monitoring (air, surfaces, and particle monitoring) in classified areas

• Conduct microbiological analyses (bioburden testing, sterility testing, and LAL testing using kinetic-chromogenic and gel-clot methods)

• Perform sampling and microbiological analysis of plant utilities (water, steam, compressed gases)

• Perform microbiological analysis of raw materials

• Perform sub-visible particle count testing on finished products

• Perform microbial identification

• Execute incoming testing of laboratory materials in use (GPT, bioindicator population, etc.)

• Execute method validations for LAL testing, sterility testing, and bioburden testing

• Carry out sampling and analyses required for process validation and cleaning validation activities

• Issue and complete laboratory documentation, ensuring accuracy and correctness (logbooks, protocols, and reports)

• Ensure maintenance, cleaning, and efficiency of laboratory equipment and facilities

• Actively participate in audits

Qualifications and Skills

• Degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology (CTF), or related disciplines

• At least 5 years of experience in Microbiological Quality Control within the pharmaceutical industry

• Knowledge of LIMS systems (preferred) and SAP

• Accuracy, reliability and a strong sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and a proactive attitude

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Good knowledge of the English language, knowledge of French will be considered an asset

We offer

• Fulltime permanent employment in a young working environment and positive culture.

• Sintetica promotes diversity and gender equality.
